$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFLI (AIP France, chart dated 2026-09-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Annemasse

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
Training pattern reserved for home based ACFT and HEL.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
The attention of pilots is drawn to the proximity of Geneva controlled airspaces.
Inbound flights: Recommended procedure for integration QFU 115°: After AD recognization or found out data of RWY 12 in use, report over point R at 3100 ft and join downwind leg at 2600 ft.
Flights with IFR cancellation in LSGG TMA: refer to STAR, instrument approach charts and VFR Geneva (LSGG) charts.
Under good weather conditions, IFR cancellations may occur before starting an instrument approach at LSGG.
In the event of an instrument approach at LSGG, plan to leave approach axis of LSGG at the latest at 3000 ft AMSL to join Anemasse by VFR/VMC.
If meteorological conditions do not allow it, say intentions to LSGG ATC.
The attention of pilots is drawn to the presence of a relief (Mont Salève) between VFR S point and Anemasse aerodrome.
Outbound flights: Extensive information available from aerodrome operator.; Flight with passage to IFR in LSGG TMA:.
Before start-up, contact Genève departure on FREQ (or by phone +41 22 747 13 68 in case of successive nonresponses).
Expect an IFR passage at BIVLO or towards MOLUS or CBY.
Flights with IFR passage outside LSGG TMA but in LSAG FIR: Before start-up, contact ALPS RADAR by phone 00 41 22 747 13 91.

Noise abatment procedures: All TKOF must compulsorily start from RWY threshold;; After TKOF RWY 12, make a 45° right turn as soon as possible after overflying the first houses located at the end of RWY.; After TKOF RWY 30 maintain strictly RWY axis up to the railway station.; At departure, as soon as possible after TKOF reduce to normal climb power up to the circuit end.; At arrival, set holding power rating on approach to AD.
HEL procedures: Suivre trajectoire spécifiée à 3100 (1500) pour; Follow prescribed flight track at 3100 (1500) to join or to leave HEL circuit.; Adopt if possible noise abatement procedure.
Aerobatics activity NR 6838: see AIP ENR 5.5
